faq.q: What is a growth partner for home service businesses?
faq.a: A growth partner is an outside advisor who works with a home service owner every month on getting found, converting leads, connecting systems and making key decisions. It sits between hiring a marketing agency and hiring a full-time executive, with one person who looks at the whole business.

faq.q: How do I grow my HVAC or plumbing business in the slow season?
faq.a: Use the slow season to build steady demand and fix the process. Push maintenance plans, follow up on old estimates, ask past customers for reviews, and work on your Google profile and service pages. It is also the best time to clean up your CRM and dispatch before the next rush.

faq.q: How can a home service business stop missing calls?
faq.a: Make sure every call has a clear path to a person or a quick callback. That can mean a call routing plan, an answering service, or text-back for missed calls. Then track missed calls each week so you can see if the fix is working.

faq.q: How do I get more reviews for my home service business?
faq.a: Ask every happy customer, right after the job, with a direct link. The easiest way is a text or email sent automatically from your CRM when a job is marked complete. Reply to every review, good or bad. Steady reviews help on Google Maps and in AI answers.

faq.q: Do you sell CRM or dispatch software?
faq.a: No, I work with the tools you already use. If you have a CRM, dispatch or scheduling system, I help your team use it consistently and connect it to your website, phones and accounting. If a new tool truly makes sense, you decide, and nothing is bought without your approval.

faq.q: How much does a growth partner cost?
faq.a: With Vestis, partnerships start at $3,000 a month for the first 90 days, then continue month to month. That includes a website build or rebuild, ongoing SEO and AEO, a sales process review, four owner sessions a month and support between calls. Ad spend is optional and paid directly by you.
